title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A1–B1）
section: 第 1,051–1,100 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: We have a weekly team meeting every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每週一早上都會召開團隊週會。

examples.en: The client asked to reschedule our meeting to Thursday.
examples.zh: 客戶要求將我們的會議改期到週四。

examples.en: Over twenty managers attended the annual budget meeting.
examples.zh: 二十多位經理出席了年度預算會議。

examples.en: Let's discuss our marketing strategy during lunch.
examples.zh: 我們在午餐時討論一下行銷策略吧。

examples.en: The committee met to discuss the new company policy.
examples.zh: 委員會開會討論公司的新政策。

examples.en: Have you discussed this issue with your parents yet?
examples.zh: 你跟父母討論過這個問題了嗎？

examples.en: The classroom discussion was lively and inspiring.
examples.zh: 課堂上的討論非常熱烈且富有啟發性。

examples.en: After a long discussion, we finally reached an agreement.
examples.zh: 經過長時間的討論，我們終於達成了共識。

examples.en: This topic is still under discussion by the board.
examples.zh: 這個議題目前仍在董事會的討論之中。

examples.en: Our group completed the science project ahead of time.
examples.zh: 我們小組提前完成了自然科學專題計畫。

examples.en: She is currently managing a major software project.
examples.zh: 她目前正在負責管理一個大型軟體專案。

examples.en: The government announced a new housing project for low-income families.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了一項針對低收入家庭的新住宅計畫。

examples.en: Please submit your quarterly sales report by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在週五前提交你的季度銷售報告。

examples.en: The weather report predicts heavy rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 天氣預報預測今天下午會有大雨。

examples.en: He reported the stolen bicycle to the local police.
examples.zh: 他向當地警方通報了腳踏車失竊一事。

examples.en: She delivered an impressive slide presentation.
examples.zh: 她進行了一場令人印象深刻的投影片簡報。

examples.en: I feel a bit nervous whenever I have to give a presentation.
examples.zh: 每當我必須做簡報時，我都感到有點緊張。

examples.en: The sales presentation convinced the client to invest.
examples.zh: 這場業務簡報說服了客戶進行投資。

examples.en: Every team member must present their ideas today.
examples.zh: 每位團隊成員今天都必須發表自己的想法。

examples.en: Only eight members were present at the morning roll call.
examples.zh: 早晨點名時只有八名成員出席。

examples.en: He bought a wonderful birthday present for his wife.
examples.zh: 他為妻子買了一份很棒的生日禮物。

examples.en: Check your daily schedule to see if you are free.
examples.zh: 查看你的每日行程表，看看是否有空。

examples.en: The train arrived twenty minutes behind schedule.
examples.zh: 火車比預定時間晚到了二十分鐘。

examples.en: We need to schedule an appointment with the dentist.
examples.zh: 我們需要和牙醫預約門診時間。

examples.en: We worked overtime to meet the project deadline.
examples.zh: 我們加班以趕上專案的最後截止期限。

examples.en: The deadline for submitting the application is tomorrow noon.
examples.zh: 申請書提交的截止期限是明天中午。

examples.en: Can you give us an extension on this deadline?
examples.zh: 這個截止日期你能讓我們寬限延後嗎？

examples.en: Break large tasks into smaller manageable steps.
examples.zh: 將大任務拆解為較容易處理的小步驟。

examples.en: Cleaning the entire warehouse was an exhausting task.
examples.zh: 清理整個倉庫是一項令人筋疲力盡的任務。

examples.en: Each student was assigned a specific task for the event.
examples.zh: 每個學生都被分配了該活動的一項具體任務。

examples.en: It is every citizen's duty to protect public safety.
examples.zh: 維護公共安全是每位公民的職責。

examples.en: The security guard was on duty throughout the night.
examples.zh: 保全人員整晚都在值班執勤。

examples.en: Import duties on luxury goods have recently increased.
examples.zh: 奢侈品的進口關稅最近有所調升。

examples.en: Ken is responsible for managing customer relations.
examples.zh: 肯恩負責管理客戶關係事務。

examples.en: Parents should teach their children to be responsible citizens.
examples.zh: 父母應當教導孩子成為負責任的公民。

examples.en: Who is responsible for the broken window in the hallway?
examples.zh: 走廊上那扇破掉的窗戶是誰該負責？

examples.en: Taking on leadership brings greater responsibility.
examples.zh: 承擔領導職位伴隨著更大的責任。

examples.en: It is our moral responsibility to care for the environment.
examples.zh: 愛護環境是我們的道德責任。

examples.en: She accepted full responsibility for the mistake in the balance sheet.
examples.zh: 她對資產負債表上的錯誤承擔了全部責任。

examples.en: The student council organized a charity book sale.
examples.zh: 學生會籌辦了一場慈善二手書義賣。

examples.en: You should organize your notes before the final exam.
examples.zh: 你在期末考前應該整理好你的筆記。

examples.en: She helped organize a surprise retirement party for her boss.
examples.zh: 她幫忙為她的老闆籌劃了一場驚喜退休派對。

examples.en: The World Health Organization monitors global disease trends.
examples.zh: 世界衛生組織監測全球疾病趨勢。

examples.en: Good organization of time leads to higher productivity.
examples.zh: 良好的時間規劃組織能帶來更高的生產力。

examples.en: He volunteered for a non-profit organization that feeds the homeless.
examples.zh: 他在一間為街友提供食物的非營利組織擔任志工。

examples.en: A good marketing strategy attracts more customers.
examples.zh: 良好的行銷策略能吸引更多顧客。

examples.en: We need a clear strategy to win the championship match.
examples.zh: 我們需要明確的策略才能贏得冠軍賽。

examples.en: The company changed its pricing strategy to compete better.
examples.zh: 該公司改變了定價策略以提升競爭力。

examples.en: She managed to finish all her homework before 9 PM.
examples.zh: 她設法在晚上九點前完成了所有功課。

examples.en: Who will manage the retail shop while the owner is away?
examples.zh: 店長不在時誰來管理這間零售店面？

examples.en: I can barely manage to wake up early on winter mornings.
examples.zh: 冬天早晨我幾乎沒辦法設法早起。

examples.en: Time management is crucial for exam preparation.
examples.zh: 時間管理對考試準備至關重要。

examples.en: The new hotel management improved customer service greatly.
examples.zh: 飯店的新管理團隊大幅提升了顧客服務。

examples.en: Stress management workshops are held every semester.
examples.zh: 每個學期都會舉辦壓力管理工作坊。

examples.en: Which department does Mr. Chen work in?
examples.zh: 陳先生在哪個部門上班？

examples.en: She was promoted to head of the marketing department.
examples.zh: 她被晉升為行銷部門的主管。

examples.en: Let's browse the clothing section in that department store.
examples.zh: 我們去那家百貨公司的服飾區逛逛吧。

examples.en: The office printer ran out of paper and blue ink.
examples.zh: 辦公室印表機的紙張和藍色墨水用完了。

examples.en: Can you connect your phone to the wireless printer?
examples.zh: 你能將手機連線到這台無線印表機嗎？

examples.en: We called a technician to fix the paper jam in the printer.
examples.zh: 我們叫了技術人員來修理印表機的卡紙問題。

examples.en: Print out two copies of the contract for signature.
examples.zh: 列印出兩份合約副本以供簽名。

examples.en: The newspaper prints over fifty thousand copies every morning.
examples.zh: 這份報紙每天早晨印製超過五萬份。

examples.en: Please print your name clearly in capital letters.
examples.zh: 請用正楷大寫字母清楚填寫你的姓名。

examples.en: Please scan this ID document and email it to HR.
examples.zh: 請掃描這份身分證件並寄給人資部門。

examples.en: He quickly scanned the headlines while drinking his coffee.
examples.zh: 他喝咖啡時快速瀏覽了新聞標題。

examples.en: The doctor recommended a CT scan to examine the injury.
examples.zh: 醫生建議做電腦斷層掃描以檢查傷勢。

examples.en: Place the photo face down on the flatbed scanner glass.
examples.zh: 將照片朝下平放在掃描器玻璃板上。

examples.en: The supermarket cashier used a barcode scanner at checkout.
examples.zh: 超市收銀員在結帳時使用了條碼掃描器。

examples.en: This portable document scanner fits right inside your backpack.
examples.zh: 這款可攜式文件掃描器剛好能裝進你的背包裡。

examples.en: Always save your document frequently to avoid data loss.
examples.zh: 經常儲存你的文件以防資料遺失。

examples.en: You must bring valid identification documents to the bank.
examples.zh: 你必須攜帶有效的身分證明文件前往銀行。

examples.en: The journalist documented the daily life of Arctic wildlife.
examples.zh: 這位記者記錄了北極野生動物的日常生活。

examples.en: Create a new folder on the desktop for English notes.
examples.zh: 在電腦桌面上為英語筆記建立一個新資料夾。

examples.en: She organized all invoices neatly into a green plastic folder.
examples.zh: 她將所有發票整齊地歸檔在一個綠色塑膠資料夾中。

examples.en: You can drag and drop these photos directly into the shared folder.
examples.zh: 你可以直接將這些照片拖曳到共享資料夾中。

examples.en: Use a paper clip to fasten the worksheets together.
examples.zh: 用迴紋針把這些學習單固定在一起。

examples.en: Do you have a spare paper clip I could borrow?
examples.zh: 你有多餘的迴紋針可以借我一個嗎？

examples.en: He bent a small paper clip to reset the router.
examples.zh: 他把一枚小迴紋針扳直來重設路由器。

examples.en: The stapler on the front desk is empty.
examples.zh: 櫃檯上的訂書機裡面沒有訂書針了。

examples.en: Can I borrow your stapler to bind these receipt pages?
examples.zh: 我可以借用你的訂書機來裝訂這些收據頁面嗎？

examples.en: This heavy-duty stapler can punch through fifty sheets at once.
examples.zh: 這台強力重型訂書機可以一次裝訂五十張紙。

examples.en: Staple the report pages in the top-left corner.
examples.zh: 將報告內頁在左上角裝訂整齊。

examples.en: Rice is a staple food for more than half of the world's population.
examples.zh: 米飯是全球半數以上人口的主食。

examples.en: We bought a large box of staples at the stationery store.
examples.zh: 我們在文具店買了一大盒訂書針。

examples.en: Many college students bring laptops to lecture halls.
examples.zh: 許多大學生帶筆電去階梯教室上課。

examples.en: I forgot my laptop charger at the office yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天把筆電充電器忘在辦公室了。

examples.en: This lightweight laptop has impressive battery life.
examples.zh: 這款輕薄型筆電具備令人驚豔的電池續航力。

examples.en: He prefers working on a desktop with dual monitors.
examples.zh: 他偏好在雙螢幕的桌上型電腦上工作。

examples.en: There are too many shortcut icons cluttering your computer desktop.
examples.zh: 你的電腦桌面上堆滿了太多雜亂的捷徑圖示。

examples.en: Graphic designers often need powerful desktop computers for rendering.
examples.zh: 平面設計師通常需要效能強大的桌上型電腦來進行算圖渲染。

examples.en: Set a strong password containing letters and numbers.
examples.zh: 設定一個包含英文字母和數字的強密碼。

examples.en: I entered the wrong password three times and got locked out.
examples.zh: 我輸入錯誤密碼三次後帳號就被鎖住了。

examples.en: Never share your account password with anyone online.
examples.zh: 絕不要在網路上將你的帳號密碼分享給任何人。

examples.en: Enter your username to log in to your student account.
examples.zh: 輸入你的使用者名稱以登入學生帳號。

examples.en: She opened a joint savings account with her husband.
examples.zh: 她和先生開立了一個聯名儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: Eyewitness accounts helped the police solve the crime.
examples.zh: 目擊者的陳述說明幫助警方偵破了這起案件。

examples.en: Log in with your school email to access online quizzes.
examples.zh: 用學校電子郵件登入以進行線上測驗。

examples.en: You need to log in before you can leave a comment on this forum.
examples.zh: 你必須先登入才能在這個論壇上留言。

examples.en: Please log in again because your session has expired.
examples.zh: 由於連線階段已逾時，請重新登入。

examples.en: Remember to log out when using public library computers.
examples.zh: 使用公共圖書館電腦時記得要登出。

examples.en: She logged out of her work account before shutting down the PC.
examples.zh: 她在關閉電腦前登出了她的工作帳號。

examples.en: For security reasons, the banking app will automatically log you out after five minutes.
examples.zh: 基於安全考量，銀行應用程式在五分鐘後會自動將您登出。

examples.en: You can download the PDF syllabus from the class website.
examples.zh: 你可以從班級網站下載 PDF 課程大綱。

examples.en: It took only a few seconds to download the mobile update.
examples.zh: 僅花了幾秒鐘就下載完了手機更新。

examples.en: The song has received over a million digital downloads.
examples.zh: 這首歌已獲得超過百萬次的數位下載次數。

examples.en: Upload your homework video before midnight Sunday.
examples.zh: 請在週日午夜前上傳你的作業影片。

examples.en: The photographer uploaded high-resolution photos to the cloud.
examples.zh: 攝影師將高解析度照片上傳到了雲端。

examples.en: Slow internet speeds can delay the video upload process.
examples.zh: 緩慢的網路連線速度會拖慢影片的上傳過程。

examples.en: Please attach your resume to the job application email.
examples.zh: 請將履歷表附在求職應徵郵件中。

examples.en: He attached a name tag to his travel suitcase.
examples.zh: 他在旅行行李箱上繫上了一張名牌。

examples.en: The hospital attaches great importance to patient safety.
examples.zh: 院方非常重視病患的安全。

examples.en: Please see the email attachment for the full conference schedule.
examples.zh: 完整會議議程請參閱電子郵件附件。

examples.en: Do not open email attachments from unknown senders.
examples.zh: 切勿開啟來自陌生寄件者的電子郵件附件。

examples.en: The baby developed a deep emotional attachment to her blanket.
examples.zh: 小嬰兒對她的小毛毯產生了深厚的情感依附。

examples.en: Write a clear subject line so recipients know the purpose.
examples.zh: 寫一個清楚的主旨讓收件人明白來信目的。

examples.en: The email had an urgent subject line that caught my attention immediately.
examples.zh: 那封電子郵件有一個緊急主旨，立刻吸引了我的注意。

examples.en: Avoid using all capital letters in your email subject line.
examples.zh: 避免在郵件主旨欄中全使用大寫字母。

examples.en: Did you send the meeting invitation to all participants?
examples.zh: 你把會議邀請函寄給所有與會者了嗎？

examples.en: I will send you a postcard from Tokyo during my vacation.
examples.zh: 我在東京度假期間會寄一張明信片給你。

examples.en: Press the blue button to send your text message.
examples.zh: 按下藍色按鈕即可發送你的文字簡訊。

examples.en: I received a notification on my smartphone.
examples.zh: 我的智慧型手機收到了一則推播通知。

examples.en: She received a scholarship to study abroad next semester.
examples.zh: 她獲得了下學期赴海外留學的獎學金。

examples.en: The company received hundreds of inquiries after the product launch.
examples.zh: 產品發表會後，該公司收到了數百件詢問。

examples.en: I will reply to your email as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 我會盡快回覆您的電子郵件。

examples.en: She received no reply to her letter for two whole weeks.
examples.zh: 她整整兩週都沒有收到對那封信的回覆。

examples.en: He replied politely that he was unable to attend the party.
examples.zh: 他禮貌地回覆表示自己無法出席該派對。

examples.en: Please forward this memo to all team members.
examples.zh: 請將這份備忘錄轉寄給全體團隊成員。

examples.en: Step forward when your name is called by the officer.
examples.zh: 當長官叫到你的名字時，請向前一步。

examples.en: We look forward to meeting your family this weekend.
examples.zh: 我們期待這週末與你的家人碰面。

examples.en: Feel free to contact me if you have further questions.
examples.zh: 若有任何進一步問題，歡迎隨時與我聯繫。

examples.en: Keep this emergency contact number inside your wallet.
examples.zh: 請把這個緊急聯絡人電話放在皮夾裡面。

examples.en: Do you prefer contact lenses or glasses for reading?
examples.zh: 閱讀時你偏好戴隱形眼鏡還是普通眼鏡？

examples.en: We exchanged business cards after the business forum.
examples.zh: 商務論壇結束後我們互相交換了名片。

examples.en: His business card includes his direct phone number and LinkedIn profile.
examples.zh: 他的名片上包含他的直撥電話與 LinkedIn 個人檔案。

examples.en: Always present your business card with both hands in Japanese culture.
examples.zh: 在日本文化中，遞名片時應雙手奉上。

examples.en: Both parties carefully reviewed and signed the contract.
examples.zh: 雙方仔細審閱並共同簽署了合約。

examples.en: The employment contract outlines your working hours and salary.
examples.zh: 聘僱合約詳細列出了你的工時與薪資福利。

examples.en: Metals contract when they are cooled down.
examples.zh: 金屬在冷卻時會收縮。

examples.en: They reached a trade agreement after weeks of negotiation.
examples.zh: 經過數週談判後，他們達成了貿易協定。

examples.en: Everyone in the meeting was in agreement with the new proposal.
examples.zh: 會議上的每個人都一致贊同這項新提案。

examples.en: Sign the user agreement before creating a new software account.
examples.zh: 在建立新的軟體帳號前請先簽署使用者條款協議。

examples.en: Please sign your name on the dotted line.
examples.zh: 請在虛線上簽署你的大名。

examples.en: Dark clouds in the sky are a sure sign of rain.
examples.zh: 天空中的烏雲是下雨的明確徵兆。

examples.en: He didn't see the stop sign and ran through the intersection.
examples.zh: 他沒看見停車標誌就衝過了十字路口。

examples.en: Your legal signature is required on the passport form.
examples.zh: 護照申請表上需要您的親筆簽名。

examples.en: Beef noodle soup is the signature dish of this restaurant.
examples.zh: 牛肉麵是這家餐廳的招牌特色料理。

examples.en: He collected hundreds of signatures for the local park petition.
examples.zh: 他為當地公園請願書蒐集了數百份連署簽名。

examples.en: The flight was canceled due to the typhoon.
examples.zh: 由於颱風來襲，該航班已被取消。

examples.en: You can cancel your subscription at any time without fees.
examples.zh: 您可以隨時取消訂閱且不收手續費。

examples.en: We had to cancel our weekend camping trip because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因為暴風雨的緣故，我們不得不取消週末露營行程。
